functionalRequirement: Customers shall be able to search for new products in the database by entering item names, and upon successful search, view detailed product information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support searches for all products in the database, returning relevant results for 100% of valid item names entered by customers.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the ability to search for products, necessitating full coverage of the product database.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must return accurate product information for 99.9% of valid item name searches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies that the system must provide correct and relevant product details based on user queries.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must return search results within 200 milliseconds for up to 500 concurrent searches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick response times are essential for a good user experience when searching for products.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The search feature must be intuitive, allowing new users to perform searches without any prior training or documentation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR indicates that customers should easily search for products, which requires a user-friendly interface.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for product searches 99.9% of the time during business hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes that customers can access product information whenever needed, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that product information is not altered or corrupted during retrieval, maintaining data integrity for 100% of searches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Accurate product information is critical for customer trust and satisfaction.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to search for suggested doctors for consultation based on their symptoms or predicted diseases.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide doctor suggestions for all symptoms and predicted diseases listed in the database, covering 100% of valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive support for symptom-based doctor searches.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must return relevant doctor suggestions with a match accuracy of 95% for valid symptom queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies that the system should provide accurate recommendations based on user symptoms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must return doctor suggestions within 300 milliseconds for up to 300 concurrent searches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Timely responses are crucial for users seeking medical consultations based on symptoms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must provide engaging feedback (e.g., loading indicators) while processing searches to enhance user experience.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with potentially sensitive health information, requiring a responsive and engaging interface.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be operational and available for doctor searches 99.8% of the time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need reliable access to medical consultations, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must ensure that all user symptom data is encrypted during transmission using TLS 1.2 or higher.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive health-related information, which must be protected to maintain user privacy.
